summary: Login accepts password with trailing spaces as valid
description: Entering the correct password followed by trailing spaces logs the user in. The password should be compared exactly.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter a valid email and the correct password followed by two spaces
expected_behavior: Login is rejected with 'Invalid email or password'
actual_behavior: User is logged in and redirected to the home page

summary: Password reset link still works after being used once
description: A reset link can be reused to change the password a second time, which violates the one-time-use rule.
steps_to_reproduce: Request a password reset and open the emailed link
Open the same link again and submit another password
expected_behavior: Second use of the link shows 'This link has expired'

summary: Search shows stale results after clearing the keyword
description: After searching for 'shoes' and clearing the box, the result list still shows shoes instead of the full catalog.
steps_to_reproduce: Clear the search box and press Enter

summary: Cart quantity can be set to a negative number
description: Typing -3 in the quantity field reduces the cart total and can produce a negative order value.
steps_to_reproduce: Add any product to the cart
Open the cart and type -3 in the quantity field
expected_behavior: Quantity below 1 is rejected and the previous quantity is restored
actual_behavior: Quantity becomes -3 and the cart total goes negative

description: The phone number field accepts alphabetic characters and saves them.
expected_behavior: Inline error 'Phone number must be 10 digits'
actual_behavior: Value is saved and a success toast is shown

summary: Double-click on Pay creates two charges
description: Double-clicking the Pay button submits the payment twice and the customer is charged twice for one order.
steps_to_reproduce: Add a product to the cart and go to checkout
actual_behavior: Two charges and two order confirmations are created
